title: BUILDME refuses a ticket no outline check has read, and /sorted runs the check at every cast
owner: CC builds it; build_inspector owns the sieve, transitions owns the entry gate, skills/sorted owns its step
intention: A ticket cannot cross into BUILDME until an outline check has read it (a sixth entry lane, the_ticket_was_checked_against_the_outline), and /sorted runs `cairn outlinecheck <id>` right after every cast.
why: Akien 2026-10-26: 'the reason we did all this was so you'll know if somebody files a ticket withuot one of us investing the cognition to go look.' A check a caster must remember is the same as no check for a ticket filed by someone else (the akiendell session, a hand at a shell); the entry gate is the one door every build passes (Law 4).
traces_to: outline 10.3.5.1 (CairnCommons/CairnComponentOutline.txt); ticket 6541ccd1594c (the check); Law 4 (a rule that matters is physics); the entry gate's lanes (ticket buildme-rides-the-chart, 9adc6fddf185, cf80bdb57205)
how: One sieve in build_inspector composing outline_check.standing(), one lane in transitions.inspect_entry, the lane-counting proof lines updated, one paragraph in the /sorted skill, one new proof. Decisions D1-D6.
falsifier: Proof cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_buildme_rides_the_outline_check.py: (1) transitions.inspect_entry('<a ticket not in the live store>') lists six lanes, the sixth 'the_ticket_was_checked_against_the_outline'; (2) over a scratch commons holding the ticket and no outline_checks record, buildme_rides_the_outline_check returns exactly one finding whose check_with is 'cairn outlinecheck <id>'; (3) with only a record whose ran is false, still one finding; (4) with a record whose ran is true, no finding; (5) for a ticket absent from the scratch store, no finding; (6) skills/sorted/SKILL.md contains 'cairn outlinecheck'. And test_transitions.py and test_rehearsal.py reseal green with six lanes. Live: the next BUILDME crossing journals 'proved 6 check(s)'.
watchme: none, because the live measure is the next BUILDME crossing's journal: the entry_gate note in that component's history.json reads 'proved 6 check(s)' naming the_ticket_was_checked_against_the_outline (rendered by cairn/tools/base/transitions.py inspect_entry), and ticket 6541ccd1594c's records under CairnCommons/outline_checks/ show the check fired.
intent_berth: none, because the intention was agreed in chat and written at CairnCommons/CairnComponentOutline.txt line 10.3.5.1 (commit f26da2c7) rather than fired through /intent

decisions.text: D1: SETTLED: in cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py, directly after buildme_rides_the_rehearsal (ends at line 2301), add buildme_rides_the_outline_check(ticket: str, *, root: Path | None = None) -> list[dict], same shape: import lazily `from cairn.machines.rehearsal import rehearsal as R` and `from cairn.devices.codemother.machines.outline_check import outline_check as OC`; if R.ticket_file(ticket, root) is None: return []; st = OC.standing(ticket, root); if st['ok']: return []; else return [_finding('buildme_rides_the_outline_check', ticket, 'an outline check has read the ticket', expected=True, actual=False, lack=st['lack'], record=st.get('record'), check_with=f'cairn outlinecheck {ticket}')]. Docstring cites this ticket, outline 10.3.5.1 and Akien 2026-10-26 'so you'll know if somebody files a ticket without one of us investing the cognition to go look'.

D2: SETTLED: in cairn/tools/base/transitions.py inspect_entry (around line 1594-1621), add the lazy import `from cairn.machines.build_inspector.inspector import buildme_rides_the_outline_check as _outlined` beside _rehearsed, and append a sixth lane after the_ticket_rehearses_clean: _sieve_lane('the_ticket_was_checked_against_the_outline', _outlined(ticket), code=code, ticket=ticket), preceded by a comment: '# The sixth lane joined 2026-10-26 (ticket c66b25d122e6, outline 10.3.5.1): the cheapest reader has read the ticket beside the component outline, so a conflict with Akien\'s picture is a question before it is code.'

D3: SETTLED: proofs that count lanes change, and nothing else in them: cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_transitions.py — the identity list at lines 1520-1524 and the sieve tuple at 1532-1536 each gain 'the_ticket_was_checked_against_the_outline' last; the note assertion at 1539-1541 becomes 'the entry_gate proved 6 check(s): a_berthed_chart_chain_claims_the_ticket, the_ticket_names_its_intent_firing, the_ticket_names_its_sorted_door_firing, the_ticket_has_every_answer_it_needs, the_ticket_rehearses_clean, the_ticket_was_checked_against_the_outline'; line 1570 becomes len(record) == 6 and passed == 5; the docstring at 1510 gains 'Six since 2026-10-26 (ticket c66b25d122e6): the_ticket_was_checked_against_the_outline is the sixth.' cairn/machines/rehearsal/proofs/test_rehearsal.py:376 becomes `assert len(names) == 6 and names[4] == "the_ticket_rehearses_clean", names` (its claim — rehearsal is the fifth lane — is unchanged). Reseal both with bin/cairn test --seal; if the tester's rung 4 refuses because a claim changed, open a question on this ticket naming the lines, never work around it.

D4: SETTLED: in skills/sorted/SKILL.md section '### 5. Resolve', insert after the paragraph that ends 'stamps `cast` with today\'s date.' (before 'The artifact door\'s journal line'), a new paragraph: '**Check it against the outline** (ticket c66b25d122e6; outline 10.3.5.1). Right after `cairn cast` prints the path, run `cairn outlinecheck <id>`. The cheapest reader reads the ticket beside `CairnCommons/CairnComponentOutline.txt` as it stands; each outline line the ticket contradicts, and each open `[Q#n]` in a section it touches, opens a question on the ticket. The BUILDME lane `the_ticket_was_checked_against_the_outline` refuses a ticket no check has read, and `the_ticket_has_every_answer_it_needs` holds it while those questions stand.'

D5: SETTLED: new proof cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_buildme_rides_the_outline_check.py, PROVES = {'c66b25d122e6': {'1':..,'2':..,'3':..,'4':..,'5':..,'6':..}} keyed by the falsifier teeth. Scratch world: a temp commons with tickets/<id>-x.json holding '{}' and an outline_checks/ dir, handed to the door with cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.set_diagnostic_roots({'cairn': <repo>, 'CairnCommons': scratch}) and cleared in finally (as cairn/machines/rehearsal/proofs/test_rehearsal.py:179-182 does), and root=scratch passed to the sieve. Records are written with json.dumps(..., indent=2) straight into outline_checks/ (a fixture, not a record of truth). Every import of the built code sits inside the tooth. Every tooth prints its verdict.
D6: SETTLED: this ticket crosses BUILDME only after 6541ccd1594c is PROVED, since D1 composes its standing(); until then the import would fail.

Line 1570's fixture is a CHARTLESS ticket: the chart lane fails and the other five pass (widget is not in the commons the outline sieve reads, so it returns []), hence len(record) == 6 and passed == 5 — not a healthy crossing.

The proof is already written red-first at cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_buildme_rides_the_outline_check.py: PROVES maps '1'..'6' to the tooth function names test_1_..test_6_, one per falsifier tooth, each built on a _World scratch commons as described in D5.

D1's import of outline_check is replaced (measured 2026-10-27: encapsulation_holds reds build_inspector importing cairn.devices.codemother.machines.outline_check — into_device, RULE 1). The sieve reads the RECORDS instead, as buildme_rides_the_chart reads codemother's berths: it globs R.commons(root)/'outline_checks'/'<ticket>-*.json' and is green iff any parses with ran is True; otherwise one finding with lack 'no outline check has run over <ticket>: cairn outlinecheck <ticket>', record None, check_with 'cairn outlinecheck <ticket>'. No codemother code is imported.

The proof landed in cairn commit eff1a38b (cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_buildme_rides_the_outline_check.py, 161 lines), red 6 of 6 before the build and green after; D9's record read keeps it green 6 of 6.
